file_names: Deli service block (staff behind the counter run; the walled block x=282-442 / y=546-663 whose north case [321.9,550.7,392.5,561.5] faces the front alley, so customers are served from y<550) — same as derived

Bakery title disk — same as derived. Kept because it is the only zone whose bridge reaches the crevices between the bakery tables; the customer floor it over-reached into is restored by inclusions.json

Floral title disk — same as derived. The title is printed inside the north-west back-of-house wedge, which exclusions.json now seals on its own drawn wall; the disk is kept so nothing about the derived coverage is silently dropped
Seafood title disk (bridge 20, the wider seafood-counter pass-through) — same as derived
Pharmacy title disk — same as derived. The room itself is sealed by exclusions.json off its drawn wall; the disk still closes the staff crevices around the front-right corner

Checkstand lane bank — the derived rect was [722.7,475.6,1090.9,595.9], and both its north edge and its east edge are wrong. One stray fixture, the aisle-19 end display [1069.6,483.6,1082.9,503.2], fell inside the +/-200 x +/-45 pt window around the CHECKSTANDS label (888.1,529.7) and dragged the bbox 74 pt north of the first register and 18 pt east of the last one, while the same +/-45 pt window clipped the registers' own south ends (y up to 614.1) back out. With bridge 20 that over-tall rect closed every 16-20 pt aisle mouth it covered, culling ten corridor pockets of 152-190 cells at y=476..514 (x=724..1030) and leaving aisles 9-19 enterable only from the north cross-aisle. Retightened to the register bodies themselves: the 76 fixtures that make up the bank span x=730..1065, y=557.7..614.1, padded 8 pt as the deriver does (the only other fixtures under the old rect were the aisle-19 end display that caused the problem, the front-end box [702.4,615.5,716.5,619] west of the first register, and the three vestibule-wall boxes at x=936..1056 / y=623..636). The bridge stays at 20 because checkout lanes (14-20 pt between register units) are wider than a service-counter pass-through, so the lanes still seal while the front action alley (y=514..550) and the south front walkway (y=614..663) stay open
